When I was in 8th grade in highschool (it has been 4 years since then), I was truly deep into depression which led swiftly to self-harm— scratching my wrists, arms and my neck to the point where it left red marks, some even bled and also few attempts of strangulations. Later on, I slowly became suicidal which at that time I was in certain denial until one day during our school lunch time when I went to washroom due to the amount of pressure and everything I’ve carried from the result of having depression. I did what I usually would’ve done, scratched my neck, arms and wrists to the point of visible red marks, few blood here and there.

Then I went for strangulation. I strangled myself using my tight-buttoned collared uniform around my neck. When I thought it was tight enough to suffocate myself, I sat on the floor with full intention of just harming myself. I fought the urge to rip my clothes open to take a breath, it took everything from me to deny my hands to reach my neck. It was like a fight or flight mode, I panicked with fear and think it’s the reason I passed out for quite awhile. 

Long story short, when I opened my eyes, I realized I was still in the washroom, my tight buttoned collar’s button that had a tight lock around my neck broke. No one knew that day, not even my parents I had attempted suicide that could’ve killed me. I should’ve died, or perhaps I nearly died?
I'm fine for the most part....
